summary: This is a routine Form 6-K filed by Grupo Aeroportuario del Sureste (ASUR), a Mexican foreign private issuer, reporting the resolutions approved at its General Annual Ordinary Shareholders' Meeting held on April 23, 2026. The filing covers standard items: approval of the CEO's report, audited financial statements, Audit Committee report, board activities, tax obligations, a legal reserve allocation, and an ordinary net cash dividend of Ps. 10.00 per share from retained earnings. There are no special-situation elements such as acquisitions, divestitures, restructuring, or strategic changes. This is a periodic current report on ordinary corporate governance and dividend matters, not a special situation.
